content:
Laawol ngol ndeen wonnoode ko saanga hakkunde ngam wonnde ɓeydaare wallitooɓe ɓooyɗe ɓesdoo wonnde jooɗiiɗo oto Audi TT ndaaɗo ngo ɓoyi ngam hoɓɓitaade nde hoɓɓitiraa.

Correction — here is the clean version:

Laawol nokkuure ɗo hakkunde ndu waɗnoyno ɗum, ɗum maayi seeɗa ngam sey wallitooɓe ɓooyɗe ngaɗa ɗum, ɓe ndaarii yimɓe haɓɓaaɓe nder oto Audi TT ndaaɗo.
